title: Broken Cumulative Ordering (No Propagation)
pattern: Assuming that `smp_store_release` alone provides global propagation ordering when combined with intermediate load-to-store steps.
why_bad: The cumulativity property of release-store only propagates writes that occurred *before* the release. It does not enforce ordering through a load-to-store step on CPU 1 where a subsequent write is made on CPU 2.
detection: Multi-CPU litmus test where a release-acquire chain is interrupted by a load-to-store dependency.
counterexample: Using full memory barriers (`smp_mb()`) across all communicating threads.
fix: Upgrade intermediate loads/stores to use full memory barriers.
